weather-rainy-no-watering.title: Rain usually waters outdoor crops
weather-rainy-no-watering.reason: Today is rainy, so ordinary outdoor crops are usually watered by rain. Save energy for mining, fishing, or farm cleanup.
uncertainty: Greenhouse crops, garden pots, or special tiles may still need manual confirmation.

weather-stormy.title: Check lightning rods on storm days
weather-stormy.reason: Today is stormy. Lightning rods may produce battery packs, and ordinary outdoor crops usually do not need watering.
uncertainty: Farm lightning rods are not parsed yet, so this is only a weather reminder.

season-end-planting-risk.title: Don't plant season-locked crops near the end of the season
season-end-planting-risk.reason: In the last 4 days of a season, avoid planting single-season crops that cannot mature before the season changes.
uncertainty: This reminder only uses the plan date; if you have already planted or advanced the day, use the in-game state.

harvest-ready-crops.title: Harvest mature crops
harvest-ready-crops.reason: The save shows mature crops on the farm. Harvesting them can convert them into gold.
uncertainty: Ignore this suggestion if you have already harvested after entering the game.

collect-ready-processed-goods.title: Collect finished processed goods
collect-ready-processed-goods.reason: The save shows finished goods in processing machines. Collect them to free those machines for the next batch.
uncertainty: Ignore this suggestion if you have already collected these after entering the game.

collect-animal-products.title: Collect animal products
collect-animal-products.reason: The save shows animals with products ready to collect. Pick them up and process them when useful.
uncertainty: Milking, shearing, egg collection, and Auto-Grabber state still need in-game confirmation.

animal-feed-low.title: Animal feed is below two days
animal-feed-low.reason: Current hay stock covers less than two days of animal consumption. Prepare hay or check silos to avoid animals stopping production.
uncertainty: Grazing, auto-feeder state, and today's feeding state still need in-game confirmation.

fish-for-money.title: Spend some time fishing for income
fish-for-money.reason: Fishing is a low-barrier, steady income source. This version estimates a conservative range from fishing level and weather.

get-fishing-rod.title: Get a fishing rod first
get-fishing-rod.reason: The save does not show an owned fishing rod. Before fishing for income, visit Willy at the beach to receive the Bamboo Pole.
uncertainty: If you have already received or bought a rod after entering the game, use the in-game state.

push-mines.title: Push deeper in the Mines
push-mines.reason: Progressing in the Mines unlocks deeper resources and can also provide ore, gems, and combat experience.

farm-maintenance.title: Tidy the farm and inventory
farm-maintenance.reason: When there are no stronger time-limited tasks, clearing debris, organizing chests, and preparing tools reduces friction for later days.
uncertainty: Farm debris, chest organization, and tool locations are not parsed, so this remains a fallback suggestion.
